name: Xolatoyac, the Smiling Flood
oracle_text:
Whenever Xolatoyac enters or attacks, put a flood counter on target land. That land is an Island in addition to its other types for as long as it has a flood counter on it.
At the beginning of your end step, untap each permanent you control with a counter on it.
blocked_sentences: That land is an Island in addition to its other types for as long as it has a flood counter on it.

needs.what: Rule 305.6 -- a land that gains a basic land type gains the matching intrinsic mana ability ({T}: Add {U} for Island), derived in the characteristics pipeline (characteristics.abilities_of) from the subtypes the land actually has, so that the Island an `add_subtype` op with `duration: "while_counter"` writes brings {T}: Add {U} with it for exactly as long as the type lasts, visible to legality, the payment solver and activation.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The type change itself is now sayable exactly: [{"op": "add_counters", "counter": "flood", "objects": {"target": "t1"}}, {"op": "add_subtype", "subtypes": ["Island"], "objects": {"target": "t1"}, "duration": "while_counter", "counter": "flood"}] makes the land an Island that outlives Xolatoyac and stops being one with its last flood counter. But the engine never derives a mana ability from a subtype -- data/cards/basics.cards.json prints {T}: Add {U} on Island as an ordinary ability and abilities_of consults no subtype -- so the flooded land would be an Island in name only and could not tap for {U}, which is most of what the line does. A `grant_ability` of {T}: Add {U} is not what the card says and would not end with the type. Same blocker as Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Ashaya, Soul of the Wild.
